# Source: Woman before an Aquarium

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Woman before an Aquarium
- **Artist / culture:** Henri Matisse French, 1869–1954
- **Date:** 1921–23
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Modern Art
- **AIC artwork ID:** 27984
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/27984
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/d0e36029-27fc-bf4e-357a-55cfbaf7bdfd/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Textile Pattern

## Extracted source palette

`#482818, #486878, #584838, #886858, #687888, #987878, #385858, #785838`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#25150C`
- `surface`: `#3E3028`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#482818`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#987878`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3028`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#60554E`
- `error`: `#482818`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `16.58:1`, surface `11.91:1`
- Variant contrast: `11.91:1`
- Control contrast: `12.4:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
